title: Compliance Pre-flight Output Schema
description: Structured output produced by the checker (either Claude-based checker.md prompt or heuristic run.py). Both MUST conform to this schema so downstream skills can consume predictably. Gates (Skills 07b/10, rule pre-launch-gates) decide on overall_verdict: pass | warning | critical.

severity.description: Derivada do score (0-20 low, 21-40 medium, 41-70 high, 71-100 critical), com piso na maior severity de trigger individual (1 trigger critical → severity critical).

overall_verdict.description: Decisão de gate: low → pass (salvar/publicar), medium → warning (logar + alertar), high/critical → critical (BLOCK: rewrite e re-rodar).

eixo.description: Which axis: Meta Policy, FTC, FDA, Credibility, AI Style, Universal, Pattern, or vertical-specific

informational.description: True = listado só pra contexto (padrão OK se específico/verdadeiro); não soma risk_score e não gera rewrite suggestion.

rewrite_suggestions.description: SEMPRE presente: uma entrada por flag encontrada (exceto informational). suggested_replacement = substituição padrão da rule 8b (safe_substitutions do red_flags.json) quando houver; null quando a correção exige reescrita contextual.

rewrite_suggestion.description: Reescrita COMPLETA da copy — só o passe Claude (checker.md) produz, quando severity >= high. O heurístico run.py emite sempre null.

alternative_claims.description: 3 alternative compliant claims preserving persuasion (passe Claude apenas)

vertical.description: product_vertical do manifest usado na análise

stage.description: Contexto do gate que invocou (pre_ad = skill 10, pre_page = skill 07b)

heuristic_only.description: True when produced by run.py heuristic (lightweight, ~80% accuracy). False/absent when produced by full Claude checker.md.
